sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth is extremely narrow with only Technology maintaining an all-green profile, while Energy and Healthcare show cracks in leadership.

Leadership remains highly concentrated at the top, driven by Technology (0.933 momentum) and Energy (0.817 momentum, rank 1 YTD). However, broad market participation is lacking, as just 1 of 11 groups exhibits positive performance across all timeframes. Rotational buying surfaced marginally in Communication Services and Industrials, which both improved their 5-day standings.

Meanwhile, defensive and rate-sensitive groups continue to languish at the bottom, anchored by Real Estate (0.117 momentum) and Utilities (0.267 momentum). Healthcare is showing early fatigue, losing ground over the past week despite otherwise solid longer-term momentum.

## Strength
- **Technology dominates:** Holds the highest momentum score (0.933), sits at rank 2 YTD, and is the sole sector (1 of 11) with an all-green performance profile across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD horizons.
- **Sustained leadership:** Technology remains the only sector demonstrating sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month trailing ranks.
- **Energy retention:** Maintains the top overall YTD position (rank 1) alongside a robust 0.817 momentum score.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Communication Services climbing:** Posted the largest 5-day advance, gaining 2 spots to rank 7 with a 0.567 momentum score.
- **Industrials edging higher:** Gained 1 spot over 5 sessions to reach rank 4 with a neutral 0.500 momentum score.
- **Persistent laggards:** Consumer Cyclical (rank 11, 0.350 momentum), Utilities (rank 10, 0.267 momentum), and Real Estate (rank 9, 0.117 momentum) firmly anchor the bottom tier.

## Divergences
- **Healthcare fading:** Flashing an early warning divergence as rank slipped by 1 spot over the last 5 sessions to rank 5, despite holding an above-average 0.633 momentum score.
- **Slipping underperformers:** Financial (rank 8, 0.383 momentum) and Real Estate (rank 9, 0.117 momentum) each dropped 1 rank spot over 5 days, exacerbating existing weakness.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Core technology, energy, and marine transport maintain dominant, all-green momentum, while housing and precious metals face sharp short-term rank declines.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated, with only 12 of 144 industry groups registering all-green across all time horizons. Sustained strength continues to anchor around Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing and tech hardware pillars like Semiconductors and Communication Equipment. Concurrently, Software - Infrastructure is demonstrating robust positive momentum while surging 13 spots to rank 33.

Rotations beneath the surface show acute weakness in rate-sensitive and defensive stores of value. Precious metals and real estate segments saw sharp 5-day drops, led by Silver, Gold, Real Estate - Development, and Residential Construction. Meanwhile, early turnarounds are emerging in select defensive pockets, including Utilities and Specialty Insurance, which are pushing higher in rank despite lagging underlying momentum scores.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** Just 12 of 144 industry groups are positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and year-to-date horizons.
- **Persistent Outperformers:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.992, rank 2 YTD), Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.956, rank 3 YTD), and Communication Equipment (momentum 0.948, rank 5 YTD) pace the market as sustained leaders.
- **Hardware and Shipping Moats:** Semiconductors (momentum 0.923) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.915) continue to hold sustained top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month tracking periods.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest Improvers:** Utilities - Independent Power Producers climbed 16 spots to rank 120 (momentum 0.58), followed by Internet Retail (+15 spots to rank 65, momentum 0.72) and Discount Stores (+14 spots to rank 69, momentum 0.62).
- **Steepest Drops:** Shell Companies cratered 42 spots over the past 5 sessions to rank 72, alongside heavy drawdowns in Biotechnology (-15 spots to rank 43) and Lumber & Wood Production (-13 spots to rank 83).
- **Bottom Laggards:** Financing and real estate vehicles occupy the lowest absolute momentum tiers, anchored by REIT - Mortgage (0.041 momentum, rank 134 YTD) and Mortgage Finance (0.050 momentum, rank 142 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Shell Companies dropped 42 spots in 5 days despite a 0.65 momentum profile, while Diagnostics & Research shed 4 spots despite strong 0.76 momentum.
- **Precious Metals Deterioration:** Silver dropped 13 spots to rank 36 (momentum 0.48) and Gold fell 11 spots to rank 76 (momentum 0.39), highlighting short-term capital flight.
- **Emerging Rank Jumps:** Insurance - Specialty (+10 spots to momentum 0.38) and Utilities - Regulated Gas (+6 spots to momentum 0.44) are logging early rank gains that have yet to reflect in broad momentum metrics.
